sources.label: Official Warehouse size guide (Main Range CM, Dual Size Chart, International Sizing Conversion)

notes: UK fashion brand (est. 1976), now part of the Debenhams Group (formerly boohoo group); sold on its own site (warehousefashion.com) and via ASOS. Popular on second-hand platforms like Vinted and Depop. UK sizing 4–24 (letter sizes XS–XXL each cover two UK sizes). Tends to run true. Knit and jersey items slightly more generous. Note: post-acquisition quality and sizing has evolved.
audit: Old sources were ASOS's brand page and warehouse.co.uk, which now redirects to warehousefashion.com, Warehouse's own site. Official Main Range chart is UK 4–24 (stored 6–16), single cm values; hips were 3–5 cm too small. UK 6 bust 81 -> 82.5, waist 62 -> 64.5, hips 87 -> 90.5; UK 12 bust 92 -> 95, waist 73 -> 77, hips 98 -> 103; UK 16 bust 102 -> 105, waist 83 -> 87, hips 108 -> 113. UK 4 and 18–24 added. US/EU from the page's conversion table; letter sizes from its Dual Size Chart (XS = UK 4–6 … XXL = UK 24–26) kept as altLabel. Notes corrected (sizing 4–24, Debenhams Group).
